question: The Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna award was renamed by the Government of India as Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award in the year______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2021**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award was renamed as **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award** by the Government of India in **2021**.
 
• The decision to rename the award was announced by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** on **6th August 2021**.
 
• The renaming honors the legacy of **Major Dhyan Chand**, one of India's greatest hockey players, also known as the "Hockey Wizard."
 
• The Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award is India's highest sporting honor, awarded for outstanding performance in sports and games.
 
• This renaming reflected the growing demand from the public to honor athletes who have made significant contributions to Indian sports history.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Major Dhyan Chand's Contribution to Hockey:**

 
 
• Major Dhyan Chand was a three-time Olympic gold medalist, leading India to victory in 1928, 1932, and 1936.
 
• He scored over 400 international goals during his career, earning him the title "Hockey Wizard."
 
• National Sports Day in India is celebrated on his birth anniversary, 29th August, every year.
 
 
 
• **About the Khel Ratna Award:**
 
 
• Introduced in 1991-92, it was originally named after former Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi.
 
• The award includes a medallion, a certificate, and a cash prize of ₹25 lakh.
 
• It is awarded annually by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
 
 
• **Other Prestigious Sports Awards in India:**
 
 
• **Arjuna Award:** Given for consistent outstanding performance in sports.
 
• **Dronacharya Award:** Presented to coaches for producing exceptional athletes.
 
• **Dhyan Chand Award:** Lifetime achievement award in sports and games.
